scientific_integrity: A self-contained proof supplies a universal lower-bound potential and Eulerian attaining construction; independent finite consistency and optimization checks are included as reproducibility support, not substitutes for proof. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Proved for cyclic binary hosts covering all length-k contiguous words avoiding `11`, for every integer \(k\ge2\); no corresponding theorem about linear words, other forbidden factors, or enumeration of all optimal covers. A general published min-cost-flow algorithm computes individual cases, and unindexed equivalent work cannot be excluded.
title: Exact shortest cyclic covers of the no-adjacent-ones binary language
